# er605_admin_account (Resource)

Router management account (the single admin login). Apply authenticates with the provider's current credentials and replaces them; afterwards set the provider's username/password (or ER605_USERNAME/ER605_PASSWORD) to the new values, or the next run cannot log in. Not readable back from the router: no drift detection. Destroy only forgets it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `password` (String, Sensitive) 6-64 visible ASCII characters.
- `username` (String) 1-64 visible ASCII characters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
